asset.name: ConversationTranscriptFixture
asset.description: Adversarial conversation data with streaming partials, tool calls, approvals, citations, attachments, branches, and failed generations, for every agent surface.

rationale: The most valuable fixture in the set and the hardest to fake convincingly. Overflow includes a half-arrived code fence, a tool call awaiting approval, an interrupted generation, and a message with twelve citations, which are the states agent surfaces are least likely to have been designed for.
